mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (id, login_name, email, phone_e164, password_hash, password_algorithm, status, session_generation, authorization_generation, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{account.id}, #{account.loginName}, #{account.email}, #{account.phoneE164}, #{account.passwordHash}, 'ARGON2ID', #{account.status}, 0, 0, #{account.passwordChangedAt}, #{account.createdAt}, #{account.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS account_id, password_hash, status, session_generation FROM account WHERE id = #{accountId}

INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) VALUES (#{id}, NULL, #{actorAccountId}, #{sessionId}, 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED', 'account', #{accountId}, 'SUCCESS', #{reason}, #{now}, jsonb_build_object('previousStatus', #{previousStatus}, 'status', #{status}, 'sessionGeneration', #{sessionGeneration}))
mapper.select: SELECT id AS organization_id, path FROM organization WHERE id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM account_membership WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_tenant_security_state (tenant_id, account_id, authorization_generation, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{accountId}, 0, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, account_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM role WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT code FROM permission WHERE tenant_assignable AND code IN #{code}
SELECT code, resource_type, action, description FROM permission WHERE tenant_assignable ORDER BY resource_type, action, code
SELECT id, parent_id, code, route, required_permission_code, sort_order FROM menu WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order, code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (id, tenant_id, organization_id, code, display_name, role_type, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{code}, #{displayName}, #{roleType}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO role_permission (tenant_id, role_id, permission_id, created_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{roleId}, id, #{now} FROM permission WHERE code = #{permissionCode} AND tenant_assignable
mapper.select: SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, membership.account_id, membership.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path, state.authorization_generation FROM account_membership membership JOIN organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN account_tenant_security_state state ON state.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND state.account_id = membership.account_id WHERE membership.id = #{membershipId} AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, membership.account_id, membership.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path, membership.status, state.authorization_generation FROM account_membership membership JOIN organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN account_tenant_security_state state ON state.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND state.account_id = membership.account_id WHERE membership.id = #{membershipId}
SELECT id AS role_id, organization_id, role_type FROM role WHERE id = #{roleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND role_type <> 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'

SELECT permission.code FROM role_permission assignment JOIN permission ON permission.id = assignment.permission_id WHERE assignment.role_id = #{roleId} AND permission.tenant_assignable ORDER BY permission.code

SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, membership.account_id, membership.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path, state.authorization_generation FROM membership_role assignment JOIN account_membership membership ON membership.id = assignment.membership_id AND membership.tenant_id = assignment.tenant_id AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN account_tenant_security_state state ON state.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND state.account_id = membership.account_id WHERE assignment.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY membership.account_id

SELECT role.id AS role_id, role.organization_id, role.code, role.display_name, role.role_type, role.status, role.version, COALESCE(string_agg(permission.code, ',' ORDER BY permission.code), '') AS permission_codes FROM role LEFT JOIN role_permission assignment ON assignment.role_id = role.id LEFT JOIN permission ON permission.id = assignment.permission_id WHERE role.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND role.role_type <> 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' GROUP BY role.id, role.organization_id, role.code, role.display_name, role.role_type, role.status, role.version ORDER BY role.code, role.id

SELECT membership.id AS membership_id, membership.account_id, membership.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path, account.login_name, account.email, membership.status, COALESCE(string_agg(assignment.role_id::text, ',' ORDER BY assignment.role_id::text), '') AS role_ids FROM account_membership membership JOIN organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id JOIN account ON account.id = membership.account_id LEFT JOIN membership_role assignment ON assignment.membership_id = membership.id AND assignment.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id WHERE membership.organization_id = #{organizationId} GROUP BY membership.id, membership.account_id, membership.organization_id, organization.path, account.login_name, account.email, membership.status ORDER BY account.login_name, membership.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_role (tenant_id, membership_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{roleId}, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM membership_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId} AND role_id = #{roleId}

INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{sessionId}, #{eventType}, 'account_membership', #{membershipId}, 'SUCCESS', #{reason}, #{now}, jsonb_build_object('membershipId', #{membershipId}::text, 'accountId', #{accountId}::text, 'organizationId', #{organizationId}::text))

mapper.update: UPDATE role SET version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{roleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE role SET status = 'RETIRED', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{roleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{sessionId}, #{eventType}, 'role', #{roleId}, 'SUCCESS', #{reason}, #{now}, jsonb_build_object('affectedAccountCount', #{affectedAccountCount}, 'permissionCodes', CASE WHEN #{permissionCodes} = '' THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(string_to_array(#{permissionCodes}, ',')) END))
mapper.select: SELECT device.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE device.id = #{resourceId} AND device.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT facility.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path FROM facility JOIN organization ON organization.id = facility.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = facility.tenant_id WHERE facility.id = #{resourceId} AND facility.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT device.organization_id, organization.path AS organization_path FROM meter JOIN device ON device.id = meter.device_id AND device.tenant_id = meter.tenant_id JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE meter.id = #{resourceId} AND meter.status = 'ACTIVE' AND device.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, tenant_id, membership_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, created_by_account_id, created_at, revoked_by_account_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason FROM resource_grant WHERE id = #{grantId} AND effect = 'ALLOW' AND revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT id, tenant_id, membership_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, created_by_account_id, created_at, revoked_by_account_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason FROM resource_grant WHERE membership_id = #{membershipId} AND effect = 'ALLOW' AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_grant (id, tenant_id, membership_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, effect, created_by_account_id, created_at, revoked_by_account_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{action}, 'ALLOW', #{actorAccountId}, #{now}, NULL, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, membership_id, resource_type, resource_id, action) DO UPDATE SET effect = 'ALLOW', created_by_account_id = EXCLUDED.created_by_account_id, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, revoked_by_account_id = NULL, revoked_at = NULL, revoke_reason = NULL

INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{sessionId}, #{eventType}, 'resource_grant', #{grantId}, 'SUCCESS', #{reason}, #{now}, jsonb_build_object('membershipId', #{membershipId}::text, 'targetResourceType', #{resourceType}, 'targetResourceId', #{targetResourceId}::text, 'action', #{action}))
